snippet.title: Selkie's Salvage&Co. - Trailer
snippet.description:
Help Selkie clean the ocean up in this physics-based incremental game! Get upgrades, become more efficient, pilot your vessel and look for treasure!

Coming soon to Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4984870/Selkies_SalvageCo/

Brought to you by creator of A Whole Wolfrush, and me, creator of Mondealy.
